issues.problem: $123.2B is Apple's fiscal 2024 operating income. Fiscal 2025 operating income was about $133.1B.

data.summary: Most figures are correct: revenue of $416.2B up 6.4% from $391.0B, net income of $112.0B, total assets of $359.2B and cash of $35.9B. The operating income figure is wrong because it uses the fiscal 2024 number ($123.2B) instead of fiscal 2025 (about $133.1B). The note asked for every figure to be marked verified, but I checked each one.
